messages.content: You write incident summaries in our team style. Be short and factual.

Alert: 502 Bad Gateway on checkout-api. Started 20:30 UTC, resolved after 9 min. Root cause: new checkout-api release had a readiness probe timeout of 1s, so pods were not Ready. Impact: 54% of API calls returned 502. Fix: Rolled back checkout-api to the previous version. Owner: @core-api-oncall.

[SEV1] 502 Bad Gateway - checkout-api
What happened: 54% of API calls returned 502.
Why: New checkout-api release had a readiness probe timeout of 1s, so pods were not Ready.
Fix: Rolled back checkout-api to the previous version.
Duration: 9 min (from 20:30 UTC)
Follow-up: Raise probe timeout to 3s and test it in staging.
Owner: @core-api-oncall
You write incident summaries in our team style. Be short and factual.

Alert: OOMKilled on report-worker. Started 10:05 UTC, resolved after 9 min. Root cause: report-worker loaded too much data in memory and hit its 512Mi limit. Impact: jobs in report-worker restarted 3 times, reports delayed. Fix: Disabled the new flag and raised memory limit to 1Gi. Owner: @payments-oncall.

[SEV2] OOMKilled - report-worker
What happened: Jobs in report-worker restarted 3 times, reports delayed.
Why: Report-worker loaded too much data in memory and hit its 512Mi limit.
Fix: Disabled the new flag and raised memory limit to 1Gi.
Duration: 9 min (from 10:05 UTC)
Follow-up: Process rows in batches instead of loading all at once.
Owner: @payments-oncall

Alert: Database connection refused on search-api. Started 02:30 UTC, resolved after 25 min. Fix: Restored orders-db and restarted search-api pods. Owner: @core-api-oncall.

Owner: @core-api-oncall
